newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary appoints Suchman trade, industry minister.
newsitem.headline: Hungary appoints Suchman trade, industry minister.

text.p: Hungary's Tamas Suchman, until now minister without portfolio for privatisation, has been made Minister of Industry and Trade, President Arpad Goncz's press office said on Friday.
The appointment of Suchman, a member of the ruling Socialist Party, is effective from September 6.
It follows the resignation of Imre Dunai, an independent named to the post last year. The government said Dunai resigned for health reasons.
Press reports said Dunai probably fell out with the government over the issue of rate hikes for power companies. He favoured bigger increases than the cabinet thought publicly acceptable.
The job of minister without portfolio for privatisation will be merged into the industry and trade ministry portfolio.
